description: Grounding Totem 6% of base mana Instant 15 sec cooldown Requires Shaman Requires level 30 Tools: Air Totem Summons a Grounding Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that will redirect one harmful spell cast on a nearby party member to itself every 10 seconds. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 45 sec.
name: Grounding Totem
